title: Watch: Why does Prince Harry want to 'work it out' with his father and brother?
originalTitle: Watch: Why does Prince Harry want to 'work it out' with his father and brother?
content:
The Duke of Sussex has said he wants to "to work it out" and repair his relationship with his father and brother.

Speaking to GQ Magazine in New York, external, Prince Harry also said: "with everything else that's going in the world, the most important thing is to reconcile".

BBC culture and royal correspondent Noor Nanji breaks down what he said in the magazine interview and what it means for the royal family going forward.

Read more about what the prince said here.
